article.story: NORFOLK, Va. -- — Wyatt Fricks had 24 points in Marshall's 81-79 victory over Old Dominion on Wednesday. Fricks also had 13 rebounds for the Thundering Herd (16-9, 8-4 Sun Belt Conference). Jalen Speer scored 18 points while shooting 7 of 14, including 4 of 8 from beyond the arc, and added 10 assists. Noah Otshudi shot 7 of 12 from the field and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 18 points. LJ Thomas led the Monarchs (8-18, 4-9) in scoring, finishing with 18 points, five assists and two steals. Ketron Shaw added 16 points for Old Dominion. Caelum Swanton-Rodger finished with 15 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
